genxml.title: configuration block of the module controller's non-volatile store
genxml.doc: Byte addresses inside block 7 (0x700 to 0x7ff) of the module system controller's non-volatile store, the controller-reserved part that the host-side request set reaches. The marker byte at 0x700 and the module number at 0x708 are already read from the host driver (defs/elsc_host.toml); the offsets here are the other bytes of the block as published in the public Linux SN driver history. None of them is confirmed against a shipped image yet.
